name: Phrolova

tierList.prydwen: T0.5 Tower of Adversity, T0.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Havoc Rectifier DPS built around her puppet partner Hecate, dealing roughly half her damage on-field and half off-field during her 24s Maestro Ultimate state. Uses a 'Volatile Note' (Strings/Winds/Cadenza) music-themed Forte system feeding a big self-ATK buff and off-field Hecate attacks. No Energy Regen requirement (0 max Energy Ultimate).

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Movement of Life and Death (3 hits), Havoc.
skills.resonanceSkill: Whispers in a Fleeting Dream - Havoc hit, enters Reincarnate (enables Forte finisher).
skills.forte: Rhapsody of a New World - governs Volatile Notes (max 6) -> Aftersound stacks (CRIT DMG ramp) -> Compose/Resolving Chord states feeding Scarlet Coda and the Maestro Ultimate.
skills.liberation: Waltz of Forsaken Depths - 0 max Energy, no Energy cost; enters Maestro (120% self-ATK buff, commands Hecate for 24s).
skills.intro: Suite of Quietus (or Suite of Immortality post-Ultimate) - Havoc strike.
skills.outro: Unfinished Piece - 20% Havoc DMG / 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification to next character for 14s or until swap; extra Hecate attacks if cast during Maestro.

echoSet: Dream of the Lost (100%, best - only usable on Phrolova, 20% CRIT Rate + 35% Echo Skill DMG, 3-piece + 2-piece of choice: Havoc Eclipse/Midnight Veil recommended, or Endless Resonance/Reel of Spliced Memories, or Frosty Resolve)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Cantarella is the strongest personal-damage synergy; needs her Signature weapon to compete with top DPS.

teams.name: Heavy Attack Buff Teams
teams.notes: Phrolova can buff Heavy Attack DPS via Outro while dealing her own large damage off-field.

rotation: Opener (switch-in, no Intro): Basic 2,3 -> Forte: Basic/Skill -> Skill: Whispers -> Forte: Basic/Skill -> Basic 1,2,3 -> Forte: Basic/Skill -> Heavy: Scarlet Coda -> Ultimate -> Outro. Loop: Intro: Suite of Immortality -> Basic 3 -> Forte -> Skill -> Forte -> Basic 1,2,3 -> Forte -> Heavy: Scarlet Coda -> Ultimate -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: the best Havoc DPS in the game (with Signature), deals damage both on- and off-field with strong CC and no Energy requirement, but is a near-mandatory 'package deal' with her signature weapon and unique Echo set - without them she falls well behind other top DPS like Camellya.
